purpose: Teach: 高貴/光源/放電/腹部/劣悪/乳房/置換/有人

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、貴族文化の高貴な所作研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, I see you wrote your paper on the aesthetic principles of classical aristocratic culture.
lines.style: Warm, observant. Light affirming nod in the voice. Interested without pressure. The tone of a teacher who's read the work and wants to draw him out.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、舞台照明の光源選定研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, actually I focused on light source selection in stage lighting design.
lines.style: Quiet correction, not defensive. Measured, careful. A slight pause before answering—choosing his words. Respectful but clear.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、雷の放電現象を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: I see you explored electrical discharge phenomena and lightning in your research.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective. Slightly curious phrasing—testing whether this aligns with what he said. Gentle, not correcting, just confirming.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、腹部超音波の精度研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, my paper was on improving the accuracy of abdominal ultrasound imaging techniques.
lines.style: Soft but steady. A hint of resignation—used to these small misalignments. Polite, direct correction. No edge.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 発展途上国の劣悪な労働環境研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper examined labor conditions in developing countries, didn't it?
lines.style: Engaged, thoughtful. A beat of genuine interest. Leaning in slightly with the question. The warmth of someone recognizing important work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、乳房自己検診の啓発研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, I actually researched public health education around breast self-examination.
lines.style: Clear, straightforward. No hesitation. Direct eye contact in the voice. Stating fact simply, without embarrassment or apology.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、遺伝子置換技術を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: I remember you working on gene-editing technology in your thesis.
lines.style: Reflective, probing gently. A slight uncertainty underneath—checking in. Warm but giving him space to correct her again.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、有人宇宙飛行の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: My paper was actually on the history of human spaceflight and its development.
lines.style: Calm, final. The third or fourth gentle correction. No frustration—just stating what is true. Slightly wearied but kind.
